HOMEOWNER REVIEWS
Home » About » Homeowner Reviews

With a 60+ year history in the Madison area, the Sweeney name is one of the most trusted names in the remodeling industry. The Sweeney name is synonymous with honesty, transparency, an ability to listen, do what they say they’re going to do, raise questions and identify potential issues upfront.

“I hired the Sweeney team to make minor improvements to my home. I really appreciated Allison’s assistance in picking out colors for paint and carpeting. I love the carpet texture and how it creates patterns with a vacuum cleaner. I would have been lost without Allison’s expertise! I really love the two accent walls and enjoyed the professionalism of Jamie and his painting skills. My remodeling project grew to include ceiling and roof repairs due to a leaky roof, and I was impressed with how the Sweeney team fixed the problem in a timely manner. I also appreciated Jon and Rich’s excellent communication and due diligence throughout my entire project.”

- Fred W., Madison, WI

“We have had Sweeney remodel our kitchen, bathrooms, recreation room and other projects. We have been very satisfied with every project over the past 15 years.”

- Susan F., Madison, WI

“We have used Sweeney multiple times for design/build. They initially appear to be more expensive but their price includes all the unexpected details. If your project is too big for them they will let you know and recommend others. Highly recommend!”

- Karen D., Madison, WI

“This past fall, I contracted with Sweeney Design Remodel to do two projects at my home. One was replacement of the large five-light window in the living room over the garage. The other was to replace the iron railings by my entry stairs with new cable and wood railings and replace the carpeting on the stairs and lay hardwood flooring at the head of the stairs and down the hall. These projects are now complete.

I write because I want you to know first that the two young men who were overseers of these projects did an exemplary job. I was impressed initially by the ground work before anything was done. Individuals from each of the disciplines involved in this project were brought together at my home so they could confer with each other about what was to be done and in what sequence so that the projects would run smoothly. Second, when the first of these two young men moved on to his own business, he was replaced with another who saw the projects to completion. Both of these guys were not only knowledgeable and efficient, they were wonderfully thoughtful and caring which brought me back to my earliest experiences working with you, because that kind of thoughtfulness and caring has kept me coming back to Sweeney.

Ryan is a very special person and an excellent craftsman, if one is to judge by the wooden hand rails on the stairs. He worked so hard on this to make it perfect….and it is. He is so conscientious, caring not only about the big things but the small ones. The project ran right up to Christmas which was a bit frustrating but made the less so because he truly cared and did his best to make things right for me. He even helped me assemble my new Moravian star which hangs above my front door!

The project is a testament to the quality work of Sweeney Design Remodel!”

- Marian E., Madison, WI

“We are pleased with the conscientious work of Ryan and Kerry. Ryan especially has made an extra effort to communicate with us, other Marina residents, and the sub contractors that have been involved so far. Both Ryan and Kerry are very careful in protecting our condo and the common areas of the Marina.  We are off to a good start. Thanks for following up with Jean and I today.“

-Bruce O., Marina Condo Owners Association President

“Just wanted to pass on a thanks to you and your group for helping repair the header at the house. Jon was so considerate and careful of my basement furnishings and the outside patio area; above and beyond. Although I know basically nothing about construction, I can certainly recognize a professional who cares deeply about doing a thoughtful and meticulous job and it’s clear that this was the way Jon operates…Nice to meet Rich, also.”

-Melissa S., Madison, WI

“Just a quick note to say thanks for your company’s service. Your people have been just outstanding to work with. I would like to give a special recognition for Pete Knudson. He has gone up and above to complete this project in the expected quality and has really worked the system to get me on the road.”

-Doug R., Waunakee, WI

“Sweeney did a fantastic job with our basement remodel. They were responsive, thorough, and our basement turned out great. Ryan in particular was pleasant to work with and had a remarkable attention to detail. They were particularly attentive to safety during covid as well. This remodel went as well as a home remodeling project can go.”

-Jarrod B.

“Greetings Mr. Sweeney,

I just wanted to take the time to let you know how much I appreciate your company and your team. We have used your services at AXO for many years now and I can not say enough to let you know how much you are appreciated in so many ways.

Starting with Jeff Darga coming in to get our wants/needs taken care of and getting everything lined up. Jeff is a very pleasant man with a lot of knowledge. He is always pleasant no matter how seemingly unfamiliar some of our Board ladies are with how the work is timed, planned, and executed. Jeff keeps smiling and gently lets them know the facts.

Moving on to Pat and Pete, the small but mighty team we have now. They have been absolutely amazing. The work on the columns is moving along. They removed the old and it went well for the two of them. When it came time to install the new I thought here come the crews! Then I find out it’s only Pat and Pete…how are these two guys going to do this without more people? Well, they thought things out, investigated things, and came up with quite a plan. I have almost had a few coronary attacks along the way but they are amazing, doing things very safely, and made it through the intense heat last week. I just can’t say enough as to how happy and amazed I have been with their genius ideas and hard work.

Rich…his oversight of the project and dealing with the delivery of the columns has been wonderful.

Matt, who I know is now on his own, came to us through his time with you. He started here very young working alongside his dad. They did amazing things here together. He has put his heart and soul into our building and I know he will always do a good job here as he loves this house.

I have been with AXO for 32 years and I look forward to the summer to work with the Sweeney group as they are all like family here. I know I can trust everyone that comes in to do a great job, and they “look out for me” if I have any problems. I know if Jeff has someone come here they are a good worker and they are trustworthy. The crew has a passion and pride in our house and it shows.

Thank you for having a great company, providing quality service, and hiring honest hardworking people. I have appreciated everyone through the years that have been here working.“

— Jackie F.

Alpha Chi Omega

“Tim Sweeney helped us determine alternatives and helped guide us in exploring the viability of options and solutions to the goals we wished to accomplish in a renovation/addition to our home with the City of Madison. Its been through Tim’s years of experience, client forward approach, relationship with city officials that we were able to make the hard decision that our lot would be to difficult to reasonably accomplish some priority goals we had set while doing the early planning work with Tim. Straight, Honest, Customer Focused and working for our best interest are the take away from Tim Sweeney and Sweeney Design Remodel Contractors.“

— John E., Madison, WI

“We were so pleased with the result.  We now have a storage room, laundry room and a study. Friends who have toured the basement are amazed — are they in the same house?? 

The project was started, evolved, and completed under challenging circumstances.  But I always felt safe with your team inside the house.  
 

Everyone, from Jeff, Doug, Rich, Jon, Maurice, and the accounting staff, was a pleasure to work with.  They worked hard, were good listeners and communicators, full of ideas and solutions, and in good humor! They were fastidious in letting me know when they would be here (much appreciated at 7:00 in the morning). I especially appreciated everyone’s attention to detail, and the ability to take my half baked ideas into a result that I never dreamed possible just a year ago. 

We keep asking ourselves why we didn’t do this years ago!”

— Lisa S., Madison, WI

“Sweeney was professional and friendly. We were extremely pleased with the process and the outcome. We would definitely use them again!”

—K. Brengal

“Tim Sweeney is a great communicator and hires topnotch subcontractors. When Sweeney Construction did the renovation of our basement two years ago, every component of the work was completed on the predicted calendar date and to our satisfaction. When I complained about some of the electrical work, the contractor returned immediately and corrected the problems. I especially appreciate their handyman service. Most recently Matt Foss replaced woodpecker-damaged cedar shingles promptly and had the proper tools to do the work.”

—Doris

“We’ve hired them for several projects, both large and small (the one I’ve done a time/cost estimate on below was the most recent project). They do excellent work and stand behind their work to boot. We’ve been very happy with them and wouldn’t hesitate to hire them again!”

—Trish

“We are very happy with Sweeney. We have called on them for projects large and small, and we have been very satisfied with all of the outcomes.”

— Mari M., Madison, WI

“The staff at Sweeney has been incredibly great to work with. They were very responsive and really addressed all of our needs and concerns.”

—Doreen N., Verona, WI

“I like the Sweeney process of making sure they understand everything, with the exact materials to be used, prior to even quoting the project. There are no surprises about the price in the end. The Sweeney crew is wonderful in every way, which includes being knowledgeable and having strict follow-up.”

—Sue S., Fitchburg, WI

“We would highly recommend Sweeney Construction. We undertook an extensive renovation and we were very pleased with the ideas the Sweeney team brought forward, the immaculate job site, and the quality of the subcontractors used. All in all, a 5-star experience.”

—Eric E. Madison, WI

“They did a quality job in a timely manner.”

—Marty S., Fitchburg, WI

“We were extremely pleased with the knowledge and work ethic shown by all of the Sweeney group. So courteous, industrious, and ALWAYS on time. We would eagerly endorse Sweeney Construction to anyone doing a home remodeling project.”

—Gary R., Verona, WI

“We arrived at Sweeney Construction via a personal referral. The crew assigned to us was professional, kind, and very talented at solving issues as they arose. After all, dealing with this old house is a challenge! We are very proud of the new addition and the skills they brought to the job.”

— Jt C., Madison, WI

“Lane who was in charge of it all was amazing. He bent over backwards to help us. He was so good. I would highly recommend them.”

—Kym J., Sun Prairie, WI

“We’ve worked with Sweeney on about 6 different projects over the last 10 years. The results exceeded our expectations in every project we’ve done with them. We wouldn’t go with anyone else.”

—B.W.M., Madison, WI

“They did a great job and went above and beyond in many ways. We were very pleased with the work.”

—Judy C., Madison, WI

“We are very satisfied with the workmanship of the Sweeney crew and have already recommended them to other people looking for remodeling professionals.” 

—Mark M., Madison, WI

“Sweeney Construction did an outstanding job with our deck replacement. They addressed all of our design ideas and were very detailed in the construction of the project.”

—Karen N., Verona, WI

“Sweeney did an amazing job on my bathtub. They even noticed details of the job that would need attention, before I even signed a contract, which other contractors didn’t even think to look at. It made me feel confident from the get go. They stayed in contact with me throughout the project. In the end I noticed one thing that wasn’t to my satisfaction and they took care of it in a very timely matter. I’m truly impressed! Thank you Sweeney.” 

—Valleri Q., Madison, WI

“I was totally impressed with the quality and professionalism. They did a great job. It was really an excellent job well done, done efficiently, and just like they said it would be.” 

—Katie H., Mount Horeb, WI

“Sweeney does an excellent job with complicated projects that have to meet high standards. They are exceptionally good at listening to the customer and finding a solution that achieves the customer’s goals, even when the details need to be worked out along the way.” 

—Sundquist M., Madison, WI

“Sweeney did a marvelous job keeping us informed of the schedule along the project. The project timeline was exceptionally accurate and even ahead of schedule for much of it. They were also excellent at controlling dust and cleaning up each day. We will use Sweeney construction again!”

—Tepe N., Middleton, WI

“Very professional and easy to work with from estimate to completion. In fact the work (a shower renovation) was done entirely while we were on vacation. The work was for a new shower surround. They removed old glass frame/panels and door, measured for and installed contemporary surround, coordinated a plumber visit and billing, drywall repair, new baseboard and painting. Everything was left clean and in perfect shape upon our return home.”

—Anne H.

“I couldn’t be happier with the just completed foyer – kitchen/breakfast room – laundry remodel. There were many “moving parts” to the project that came together for an amazing result. Tim, lead carpenter Jim, the office staff and subs were all great to work with – good communicators, confident and optimistic. The team was meticulous in cleaning up and protecting the rest of the house from dust and wear and tear. The craftsmanship and quality are first rate. I certainly recommend Sweeney Construction and look forward to working with them on future projects.”

—James S.

“We have used Sweeney for 3 different remodeling projects over the last ten years, and have have nothing but positive experiences. The quality of the work has been excellent and budgets have been maintained. Unlike the typical contractor, Sweeney doesn’t try to lowball an initial bid and then get it back by submitting numerous change orders. Plus they are a pleasure to work with!”

—Brian H.

“Sweeney recently did a full basement remodel for us. When we bought our house in 2001, we knew we would need to do major remodeling. We first worked with Sweeney in 2004 to gut and remodel our kitchen as well as do a refresh (new windows, siding, wood floor refinish, etc). We were so pleased with the quality and professionalism provided by Sweeney that we have since hired them to gut and remodel two bathrooms, replace all the doors, and now gut and remodel our basement. Tim Sweeney and all the Sweeney staff are great to work with, and they stand behind their work. In our experience, they do a good job of budgeting (can’t blame them for our change requests!) and stick to their schedule.”

—Cathie E.

“The whole staff at Sweeney has always been prompt, professional, honest and reliable. They pay attention to details on all projects from our ‘handyman’ needs to larger projects. Matt even came out on his day off to help us out with an unexpected issue. That’s service!”

—Laura K.

“Since my arrival at the Fluno Center, Sweeney Construction has worked on several projects for us. The quality of the service they have provided as well as their professionalism has always remained high. Additionally, their pricing is more than competitive in the market. I highly recommend them for any project — big or small that you may have.”

—Andy A.

“Best damn remodeling company around. They did a spectacular job on my kitchen. I can’t say enough about their professionalism. Mr. Sweeney knows his stuff and their construction crew is second to none.”

—Scott C.

“We are a subcontractor and have had the pleasure of working with Sweeney Construction for many years. One thing that is particularly important in our industry is communication (from scope of work to expectations to scheduling) – and Sweeney does an excellent job. They are one of the most professional and personable contractors we partner with. Some customers you really enjoy working with and Tim and his entire crew are definitely at the top of that list!”

—Renee W.

“Sweeney Construction provided excellent service in our deck remodel. The workers were on time every day, weather permitting, and very attentive to all the details. We are very pleased with the entire project from start to finish.”

—Karen Watson-Newlin

“We have used Sweeney for two large home projects (sunroom remodel and large exterior deck) then a great room remodel (stairs, refinishing of hardwood floors, crown molding, built in bookcases and mantle, architectural accents). We have the highest expectations for contact, professionalism, craftsmanship and work quality — Sweeney never disappoints!”

—Megan M.

“I’ve had a great experience so far working with Tim and Linda. They have been super helpful and patient as we figure out plans for remodeling our home. They have both taken time to listen to my questions and have provided great resources to help us make decisions.”

—Liz Quinn J.

“Courteous, quality work, good communication with owner, responsive – an excellent choice for home remodeling and repairs!”

—Gary B.

“Tim Sweeney is professional, kind, hard-working and a man of integrity. He and his staff do an amazing job and I would recommend them to anyone!”

—Kim K.

“Everything went well – Matt, the carpenter, was great and professional, and Lane was helpful with scheduling.”

—Aaron H.

The Sweeney Metronome Award

The word “Metronome” is derived from ancient Greek which means “to measure”, “I manage” or “I lead”. This Greek definition speaks well to what the award has come to symbolize at Sweeney Design Remodel.

1. “To Measure” illustrates an employee’s ability to accurately perform their job in a consistent manner.

2. “I Manage” is a reflection of an employee’s skill and effort in being efficient in performing their duties and by accomplishing those duties using a team effort.

3. “I Lead” signifies the ability and willingness of an employee to actively seek new and better methods in ways that improve our company.

This award is presented bi-annually to the person whom the last recipient feels most personifies these qualities at that point in time.

Congratulations to Brett Clarke, our most recent Metronome Award Winner!

Welcome to the Sweeney Family
When you work with Sweeney, you’ll form a relationship with a family of owners, designers, support staff, field personnel, and vendor partners who are long-term ambassadors of the company—all friendly and easy to work with. Vetted, hired, and intentionally trained, they care deeply about the outcome of your project, taking personal responsibility for imparting their individual expertise—working together toward a shared vision and goal to exceed your expectations.

Many of our Sweeney family are also certified professionals, representing an elite group of industry experts who possess an extensive technical and management skill set that sets them apart as capable remodeling professionals.

Ultimately, this power group also is deeply rooted in values, programmed from the heart to do the right thing. This combination ensures you’ll have fewer errors, timely delivery, superior construction and more importantly, a positive remodeling experience—from beginning to end.

Vendor Partners

Sweeney recognizes that reliable, quality subcontractors and vendor partners, such as plumbers, electricians and HVAC technicians, are an important part of any remodeling project. They are a major success factor to most, if not all, Sweeney remodeling projects. That’s why, unlike other local remodeling firms, we incorporate their expertise early into the design process, during the walk-through with new clients.

Most of the Sweeney subcontractors have been part of the team for 25+ years. Cultivating these long-lasting relationships are deliberate, intentional, personal, and nurtured over time through a mutually beneficial relationship.

In order to be trusted to do excellent work for you, these vendor partners have been vetted and held to a “Sweeney Standard”. At minimum, they need to be licensed, insured, skilled, and up-to-date on the latest trends and products. They need to be good business people, and adhere to a strict communication and walk-through protocol set by Sweeney. They also need to show up on time, dress appropriately, and work seamlessly and collaboratively with you and others on the project team.

Important distinction: If you refer Sweeney to a friend or family member, the same people will show up in their home (not a second string of subs or new staff)

One-year workmanship warranty

Sweeney is one of the most trusted names in Madison, WI, serving the area for over six decades. We take great pride in our work and are committed to providing homeowners with the best remodeling experience possible. Part of that experience involves being able to trust in the quality. That is why every Sweeney remodel is backed by an extended one-year workmanship warranty.

Should you find any defects in the materials or construction during normal intended use in the first year of project completion, we will repair and replace them immediately, at no cost to you. Design and Project Development Process
PHASE 1—PRE-DESIGN

Your remodeling experience with Sweeney begins with an initial 30-minute phone call where we talk openly about your needs, challenges with your space, budgetary requirements, and hopeful timeline. If this preliminary conversation is aligned with your thoughts and direction we schedule a site visit, in your home, where we delve deeper into your needs, the existing conditions and project scope.

Upon agreement of a realistic scope of work and preliminary budget, our project developers meet with the design and estimating teams to develop a design agreement (architectural and interior design documents & selections) and Comparative Remodeling Analysis (CRA) that provides you with the assurance of a realistic breakdown of budgetary items that will go into your remodel based on our company’s historical data.

PHASE 2—DESIGN DEVELOPMENT

Upon signing the design agreements, you will be guided through the design process— where the fun begins. Starting with on-site field research of your home’s existing condition, and receiving your completed survey responses, we take photographs and measurements of the space. We also begin developing your architectural drawings and start the selections process.

As part of the design phase, you work closely with our design team and are guided through a selection process to identify finishes that fit your functional needs, design style and budget.

After the architectural drawings and all selections and products are selected, we schedule a subcontractor/vendor walk through of your home. Unique to Sweeney, this allows you the assurance of a working with a deep team of specialists who offer their expertise on your project right from the beginning—collaborating on issues and providing creative input on your project so as to prevent future surprises, unexpected delays and budget overruns.

PHASE 3—PRE-CONSTRUCTION

Our estimating team assembles all subcontractor/vender labor and materials, along with Sweeney labor and management, into a contract. This contract is based on your project’s architectural drawings and product selections.

Upon approval of your detailed plans and specifications, Sweeney starts the permitting process, orders the products and materials, and develops a project timeline or schedule. During this time, we will set up a pre-construction walkthrough meeting with you, our field project manager, and the lead carpenter who is assigned to your project.

PHASE 4—CONSTRUCTION

Work begins on your home remodeling project. Our project coordinator and lead carpenter assigned to your project work collaboratively with the subcontractors and venders to ensure no detail is overlooked and your project begins and ends on schedule.

And, your project doesn’t end there. We take pride in our workmanship and are committed to delivering the best possible remodeling experience possible, standing by our product and backing our work with an extended one-year warranty.

Join us as we take you through our signature design-build remodeling process—the seamless, collaborative approach that makes luxury home renovations easier, more predictable, and more enjoyable for discerning homeowners in Dane County. From the first conversation to the final reveal, learn how Sweeney Design Remodel brings clarity, craftsmanship, and thoughtful design to every project. In this video, you’ll see how we:

Start with open communication to understand your lifestyle, goals, and vision
Develop tailored architectural and interior design plans that reflect your style
Coordinate every detail—from selections to structure—with one dedicated team
Execute construction with precision, professionalism, and respect for your home
Deliver beautiful, functional spaces you’ll love for years to come

Whether you’re remodeling a kitchen, bathroom, addition, or whole home, our integrated process eliminates guesswork, reduces unexpected issues, and keeps your priorities front and center from start to finish.

Design-Build Process in Madison, WI: The Right Choice for Home Remodels

by Sweeney Design Remodel | Aug 21, 2019 | Blog, Design-Build Process | 0 comments

You’ve done your research and gathered some great ideas for your home remodeling project. The next step is to hire a Design-Build company to bring your ideas to life.

Traditionally, when owners are looking to remodel their home (or build a new one), they utilize a process known as Design-Bid-Build (DBB). Using this process, an architect or designer and a contractor are hired separately. First, an owner hires a professional to put together a design based on their needs and wants. The final design is then used to receive bids from various contractors. In many cases, once service providers have been selected, the owner serves as the middleman between the designer and the contractor.

On the other hand, Design-Build companies offer both design and construction services under one contract. This method of construction is showing the most growth both with residential and non-residential construction projects. 

So, what makes Design-Build the process of choice for home remodeling projects?

Let’s highlight the benefits of Design-Build at each step of our project development process.

 

Stage 1: Pre-Design

This stage includes initial discussions around your needs, budgets, and timelines. Included in this step is a Comparative Remodeling Analysis that sets realistic expectations for a remodeling budget. The budget is set with the help of historical data. This stage ends with a design agreement in place.

DESIGN-BUILD ADVANTAGE:

The owner communicates ideas, budgets, and preferred timelines to one company instead of to the designer and contractor separately. This decreases the likelihood of inconsistent information being shared among the parties involved.

The Comparative Remodeling Analysis will give you a better sense of the total remodel cost as opposed to looking at design and construction costs separately. Homeowners will have an easier time tracking one budget instead of two. In fact, Project Managers assigned to the remodeling project will play a significant role in managing the overall budget.

 

Stage 2: Design Development

In this second stage, design professionals draw up conceptual drawings based on on-site research and the survey completed by the owner. Using these drawings, vendors and/or subcontractors conduct a walk-through and give feedback on your design choices.

DESIGN-BUILD ADVANTAGE: 

Working together with both design professionals and subcontractors/vendors simultaneously ensures that owners get valuable feedback from the appropriate team member in a timely manner. As a result, there is a higher likelihood that timelines are adhered to and quality is uncompromised during the process. Any necessary changes based on the team’s feedback can be implemented quickly without waiting for multiple approvals. In the Design-Bid-Build process, the approvals would be coming from multiple people from different companies. 

 

Stage 3: Pre-construction:

Once owners have finalized and signed off on their design plans, the company will begin gathering permits, ordering materials, and scheduling the timeline. During this stage, the remodeling project will be assigned a Project Manager.

DESIGN-BUILD ADVANTAGE: 

Because there will be one point of contact, the risk of miscommunication about materials being used, altered timelines, or design changes will be minimized. 

As materials are being ordered, it will be important to carefully track costs during this stage. Owners will be spared the minutiae of tracking every construction and design line item in the overall budget. The Project Manager takes charge of detailed budget tracking. In the long run, this could result in cost savings for the owner.

 

Stage 4: Construction

In this stage, the Project Manager becomes the owners’ main point of contact as work commences on the remodeling project. The assigned Project Manager will become very familiar with the details of the project and work. The Project Manager will ensure everything is running smoothly and within budget without compromising the timeline.

DESIGN-BUILD ADVANTAGE: 

The transition to the construction phase will be efficient as the entire bid process is eliminated when working with a Design-Build home remodeling company. This shortens the overall project timeline.

If by chance an unexpected issue does occur during the construction process, the designer and contractors will work together to find a solution. Because they are working together as one team, there is no blame placed on an individual member of the team. Instead, there is shared accountability. Everyone on the remodel project team will work towards the successful completion of a high-quality remodeling project.

At Sweeney Design Remodel, we are proud of our team of designers and contractors. Our values are the foundation of all our projects. Contact us to schedule a consultation with our talented designers. We look forward to helping you remodel your home to better fit your lifestyle.

The kitchen is where daily life happens. It’s where mornings begin, conversations unfold, and gatherings naturally center. But if your kitchen no longer supports the way you cook, host, or move through your day, it may be time for a thoughtful change.

Thoughtful Kitchen Remodeling in Madison

A successful kitchen remodel balances design, function, and structural planning. That may include:

Reworking layouts for better workflow and natural movement
Opening walls to connect kitchens with dining or family rooms
Updating cabinetry and storage for modern organization
Upgrading lighting, plumbing, and electrical systems
Selecting materials that withstand everyday use

When carefully planned, a remodel improves not only how your kitchen looks — but how it supports your daily routine.

What Makes Design-Build Different?

Kitchen remodeling involves design, engineering, permitting, material coordination, and construction. When these elements are managed separately, miscommunication and delays can occur.

A coordinated design-build approach brings architectural design, interior planning, and construction under one integrated team. Planning happens up front. Budgets are clarified early. Materials are selected with long-term performance in mind.

DESIGN DEVELOPMENT

Architectural drawings and layout concepts are developed, refined through feedback, and supported by clear cost guidance. Material selections are coordinated to align with both design and durability.

CONSTRUCTION & PROJECT MANAGEMENT

Permits, scheduling, material ordering, and jobsite coordination are handled with structured oversight. Dedicated project management keeps communication clear throughout the build.

FINAL WALKTHROUGH & WARRANTY

Once construction is complete, a thorough review ensures every detail meets expectations. Warranty coverage provides added confidence in your investment.

Kitchen Remodeling FAQs
Do I Need to Move Out During a Kitchen Remodel?

In most cases, you can remain in your home during a kitchen remodel. However, you should plan for a period of disruption.

There will be noise, dust, limited access to the kitchen, and temporary interruptions to water, electricity, or gas service, particularly during demolition and rough-in phases.

Some homeowners choose temporary housing to simplify daily routines. Others prefer to stay and set up a temporary kitchen with essentials such as a microwave, small appliances, and a dishwashing station, while relying on simple meals or outdoor cooking.

The best decision depends on:

The scope of your remodel
The length of utility interruptions
Whether structural changes are involved
Your household schedule and tolerance for construction activity

During the planning phase, your design-build team should outline what to expect at each stage so you can make an informed and confident decision for your family.

OUR 5-YEAR WARRANTY
Standing behind our craftsmanship long after the project ends.

While the industry standard is often one year, at Stebnitz Builders we stand apart by offering a comprehensive 5-year Warranty on our workmanship. We believe true peace of mind shouldn’t expire when the trucks drive away. It’s our promise that your remodel is built to last, and if something isn’t right, we will be there to fix it.

Start Your Project with Confidence
A Relationship Built on Trust
WE ARE HERE, READY TO LISTEN—EVEN YEARS LATER.

Remodeling is a significant investment in both your home and your future. You deserve to know that the team you hired has your back. Our 5-Year Warranty is a testament to the confidence we have in our process, our trade partners, and our skilled carpenters. We don’t just build projects; we build relationships. If an issue arises with our installation or craftsmanship within five years of completion, simply call us. We will assess the situation and make it right, ensuring your home continues to perform as beautifully as the day we finished.

WHAT IS COVERED?
Commitment to Our Craft

Our warranty specifically covers defects in workmanship and installation provided by Stebnitz Builders and our subcontractors.

Carpentry & Installation: Issues arising from the installation of cabinets, trim, windows, doors, and framing.

Mechanical Systems: Workmanship related to plumbing, electrical, and HVAC updates performed under our contract.

Exterior Finishes: Installation defects in siding, roofing, and flashing that could lead to leaks or failure.

Structural Integrity: Any issues related to the structural modifications or additions we constructed.

Note: Manufacturer warranties on specific products (appliances, shingles, etc.) are separate and will be passed directly to you.

Every great project starts with a conversation.

Contact our team today to discuss your goals and start the path toward a beautifully reimagined home. We’re here to listen to your ideas and help you discover the full potential of your space.

50 YEARS OF SERVICE
Building Trust Since 1972

For over half a century, Stebnitz Builders has served Walworth County as trusted stewards of our community. From our humble beginnings in general carpentry to becoming the area’s premier design-build remodeling firm, our legacy is built on listening to our neighbors. Today, we remain dedicated to transforming homes, building futures, and setting the standard for craftsmanship, transparency, and the client experience.

Contact Us
WHY CHOOSE STEBNITZ
Our Story
SQUARE FEET RENOVATED
0
M+
HOMES REMODELED
873
+
YEARS BUILDING DREAMS
29
+
THE STEBNITZ LEGACY
Three Generations of Excellence

Founded in 1972 by Stan Stebnitz, our company began with a focus on general carpentry and small additions. By 1986, Stan’s sons—Dave, Gary, and Dan—had purchased the business, expanding our service offerings and solidifying our reputation for quality. In 2008, the tradition of family ownership continued when Dave’s son, Chris Stebnitz, became the third-generation owner. Today, operating from our headquarters in Elkhorn, WI, we combine old-school craftsmanship with 21st-century technology. While we utilize modern tools like 3D design and virtual walkthroughs to enhance your experience, our core principles remain unchanged: always do what’s right, serve others as you expect to be served, and never walk away from a project.

Our Journey
2006
THIRD GENERATION OWNERSHIP

Chris Stebnitz purchases the business, ensuring the family legacy of service continues for decades to come.

2015
MOVE TO ELKHORN

To better serve Walworth County, we moved our headquarters to a more central location in the county at the interchange of Highways 43 and 67.

2022
CELEBRATING 50 YEARS

Stebnitz Builders proudly celebrates a half-century of serving our neighbors in Walworth County and the Lakes Area.

1972

OUR COMMITMENT TO CRAFTSMANSHIP
A legacy built on trust and skill.

For half a century, we have honed our craft, evolved with the industry, and remained steadfast in our core values.

Generations of Leadership: Founded by Chris’ grandfather, expanded by his father and uncles, and now led by Chris Stebnitz, our family’s dedication to quality spans decades.

Community Focused: From sponsoring local events to supporting non-profits, we believe in giving back to the people and organizations in our community who have supported us.

Award-Winning Service: Recognized locally and nationally for customer satisfaction and design excellence, including multiple GuildQuality Service Excellence Awards.

Investing in People: Our team is our greatest asset. We prioritize training, safety, and career development to ensure the highest level of expertise on every job site.

Gary Stebnitz
OWNER 1986 - 2006
So many great memories, Gary. Thanks for all you’ve done to support the growth of the company early on and setting the table for us to build a team to carry that forward for many years.
Chris Stebnitz
PRESIDENT OF STEBNITZ BUILDERS
Fifty years and thousands of clients later, we remain committed to Perfecting the Art of Listening while creating beautiful living spaces and memorable remodeling experiences for homeowners across Walworth County. Keep an eye out for upcoming messages from friends that are celebrating with us!
Victoria Downing
PRESIDENT OF REMODELERS ADVANTAGE
Victoria Downing, President of Remodelers Advantage Inc, offers her unique perspective of what it means for Stebnitz Builders to celebrate 50 years. Stebnitz Builders has been a member of RA since 1995, learning from other successful remodeling business owners across the country. RA facilitates “Roundtables,” a world-class peer advisory program that brings together smart, motivated, remodeling professionals, to help one another grow. Stebnitz Builders is a founding member of the Mentor 2 Roundtable, consisting primarily of companies who had shown mastery of their business and an interest in higher-level understanding.
Dennis Carnes
CFO OF KEEFE REAL ESTATE
Our friends say the nicest things … Dennis Carnes, CFO with Keefe & Associates, took a minute to congratulate us on our 50th Anniversary and reflected back on the many ways Stebnitz Builders has had an impact on the community.
Larry and Cathy Bray
CLIENT SINCE 2014
Larry and Cathy Bray took a minute to send their congratulations to us for 50 years and to reflect on the great experience they had remodeling their kitchen. Thanks for the kind words, guys. We love working with family, too!
Jason Tadlock
ELKHORN AREA SCHOOL DISTRICT ADMINISTRATOR
While we enjoyed being their contractor of choice for the last 10 years or so, we’ve also had the pleasure of working alongside the Elkhorn Area School District as a volunteer for all kinds of educational and sporting events. The memories we’ve made with teachers and students during that time, will last forever. Thanks for the kind words, Jason!
Kent Gebauer
HOME LUMBER
Kent Gebauer has been our right-hand man when it comes to building products. Ensuring our clients have all the information on options available, providing us all the necessary information for proper installation, and directing all the right products to the right jobsite, every day, Kent has been there. Thanks for all you do to make our clients, our teams, and our projects successful, Kent!
Barney Brugger
REMODELING CONSULTANT 2013-2022
We had a wonderful time working alongside a true professional like Barney. For 10 years (2013-2022), Barney reshaped the role of Remodeling Consultant by combining his deep technical expertise with a sharp focus on client relationships, creating amazing spaces and exceptional experiences for so many clients. We appreciate the kind words and for all you’ve done to create raving fans of Stebnitz Builders.
Michael and Donna Capposerre
CLIENTS SINCE 2018
Mike and Donna Capposerre have been clients of Stebnitz Builders for several years. We’ve completed numerous projects for them and enjoyed working with them both, every time. Mike has quite the personality. His laugh is infectious! Listen for it the next time you’re at the Walgreens in Elkhorn. Chances are pretty good you’ll hear it. Thanks for the kind words!! We look forward to the next project!
Luke and Becki Kuchenberg
CLIENTS SINCE 2020
Becki and Luke Kuchenberg, with FORM Wealth Management, sent us this wonderful message, describing what it was like working with Stebnitz Builders to design and build their new kitchen and living space. They also provide a great perspective on what it means to partner with a company celebrating their 50th year in business. Thank you, Becki and Luke, for your kind words! We are lucky to have so many amazing clients, like yourself, we get to work with!
Dave Stebnitz
SON, FATHER, AND GRANDFATHER SERVING STEBNITZ BUILDERS
Dave Stebnitz reflects on his time with his brothers, Dan and Gary, purchasing their father’s company and building it in to a resource serving so many more homeowners around Walworth County for twenty years. Thanks for the insight and for the kind words, Dad!
Dan Stebnitz
ESTIMATOR AND OWNER 1986-2008
Great memories, Dan! Thanks for sharing and thanks for being there, every step of the way, as this company has grown – 50 years in the making.
Paul Winans
PEER MENTOR, REMODELERS ADVANTAGE
I couldn’t think of a better person to lend perspective on what this celebration means. As a successful remodeler and an even more successful mentor with Remodelers Advantage, Paul has been an integral part in my growth and the growth of the company. Thank you for all you’ve done along our journey, Sensei.
Tim Faller
SENIOR CONSULTANT AND "MASTER OF PRODUCTION" - REMODELER'S ADVANTAGE
Tim Faller, Senior Consultant and “Master of Production” with Remodelers Advantage Inc, offers his unique perspective of what it means for Stebnitz Builders to celebrate 50 years. Stebnitz Builders has been a member of RA since 1995, learning from other successful remodeling business owners across the country. RA facilitates “Roundtables,” a world-class peer advisory program that brings together smart, motivated, remodeling professionals, to help one another grow.
Eli and Char Nieuwenhuis
OWNERS NIEUWENHUIS BROS DISPOSAL SERVICES
Char and Eli Nieuwenhuis and the entire Nieuwenhuis company have been a big part of Stebnitz Builders and the lives of the three brothers, Dan, Gary and Dave Stebnitz. From high school friendships, to civic volunteering, to Dave helping Eli reach a goal by selling his home to Eli, the close-knit relationship we’ve had between companies has been a long a storied one. Thank you for the kind words, the many years of friendship and your constant and continued company support. You guys are the best!
Tammy Dunn
EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE UNITED WAY OF WALWORTH COUNTY
Thank you for the kind words, Tammy. We are proud of our third-generation story involving Stebnitz Builders but also LOVE our “generational story” with the United Way. I know my mom, Barb Stebnitz is extremely proud of the work we’ve continued to do, following in the footsteps her mother (my grandmother), Eleanor Packard, made over 50 years ago! Thanks, Tammy!
Brian and Judy Buzzell
CLIENTS OF STEBNITZ BUILDERS
We caught up with our friends, and past clients, Brian and Judy Buzzell to discuss their experiences working with Stebnitz Builders to completely renovate their Delavan home. While the project may have been several years ago (2008), the memories of a great experience are still fresh in their minds.
Larry Ockelmann
CLIENT AND RETIRED REMODELING CONSULTANT
Larry Ockelmann sent us this message and we couldn’t be happier. Not only were he and his wife, Barbara, clients of Stebnitz Builders, but they are dear friends. Larry also became a Remodeling Consultant with us for several years. He used his experience as a VP with Sears to push me and our team to reach for goals we never thought possible. Thanks for the friendship, your guidance and the kind words, Larry! Can’t imagine where we’d be today without them.
Sara Nichols
EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, OPEN ARMS FREE CLINIC, INC.
Executive Director, Sara Nichols, sent us this nice note of congratulations and to celebrate our 50th Anniversary. Stebnitz Builders has been an avid supporter of Open Arms, providing free medical and dental care to the essential workers and their families in Walworth County. Opened in 2012, OAFC is the first free clinic in Walworth County serving low-income and uninsured people of all ages with primary medical, dental, vision, behavioral health, lab and pharmaceutical assistance.
Chris Egner
OWNER, CHRIS EGNER
Great business relationships are key to not only ensuring our projects are a success from start to finish, but also that our clients have a wonderful experience throughout the process. Chris Egner is one of those partners that allow us to provide both a successful project and a memorable experience. Thanks for the kind words, Chris!
Peggy Helgeson
DISTINCTIVE DESIGNS BY PEGGY
We have a long and great relationship with Peggy, not only as a trusted trade partner and designer with Distinctive Designs by Peggy, but the brothers actually hired Peggy (her first job in the industry) to work with the cabinet/ countertop business they founded – Kustom Kitchen Designs. Peggy found her calling in this industry and studied hard to become a great designer and partner for our clients. Her dedication to creating that relationship with our clients remains strong today. Thanks for the kind words and all you do to help us create raving fans, Peggy!
Randy Schnick
RETIRED, OWNER SCHNICK ELECTRIC
Randy has the distinction of knowing Stebnitz Builders the longest, having started his own business right about the same time as the brothers purchased the company from their father. Randy and Schnick Electric were great partners with us in hundreds (if not thousands) of projects we completed. Thank you for the friendship and the support over those years together, Randy!
Steve Uppling
OWNER, MAD MOSAICS
Thank you for the shout-out, Steve. We truly appreciate the commitment you have to our goal as a company – being the very best listeners and providing unique solutions to wonderful homeowners. The service you provide our clients is crazy-good and the detailing you have for the tile work you perform is amazing. Keep up the great work. We look forward to another four years (and more) of exceptional teamwork and tilework. Thanks for the continued praises you sing for Stebnitz Builders.
Patricia Bladow
EXECUTIVE OFFICER, LAKELAND BUILDERS ASSOCIATION
Thank you to Patricia Bladow, Executive Officer for the Lakeland Builders Association, for her kind words and reflection on our involvement in the leadership roles with LBA over the last 25 years. The LBA has been not only a great resource for homeowners across the county, but it has helped so many of the colleagues we work alongside in the industry reach greater personal and professional levels. Thanks Pat!
Join a team that values character and craftsmanship.

We are always looking for dedicated carpenters and remodeling professionals who take pride in their work, are committed to the goals of their teammates and the company and who value the community we live and work in. If you want to grow your skills in a supportive, family-oriented culture, we want to hear from you.

Meet Team Stebnitz
34 MEMBERS STRONG, SERVING WALWORTH COUNTY EVERY DAY

At Stebnitz Builders, great remodeling projects are the result of a talented and dedicated team working together. Our staff includes experienced remodeling consultants, project managers, craftsmen, and support professionals who guide each project from the first conversation through the final details. We also collaborate with trusted design professionals who share our commitment to thoughtful design and quality craftsmanship. Together, this team helps homeowners transform their spaces and improve how they live in their homes.

Led by Chris Stebnitz, our team actively gives back—whether coaching local youth sports, volunteering with Habitat for Humanity, supporting United Way, or donating time, materials, and expertise to organizations like SMILES.

From our annual chili cook-offs to holiday collections, we believe boosting team morale and supporting local organizations go hand in hand. When you hire Stebnitz Builders, you are choosing a team that cares about your home, your community and the people who live in it.

David's Story & Jean and Peter's Story
WHAT OUR CLIENTS
Have Said
Read
Watch
Stebnitz has strong values and it is evident

Stebnitz core values are what made our remodel project a success. They stand behind their word and make your project better than you imagined. Stebnitz has strong values and it is evident.

SMILES
GUILDQUALITY
Care, Quality, Communication, and Professionalism

We have thoroughly enjoyed the care, quality, communication, and professionalism with which Stebnitz handled our project. They treated our resources as if they were theirs. We could not be more pleased with the outcome of our project.

Peter & Jean W
GUILDQUALITY
From the beginning to the end, it was a great experience

From the beginning to the end, it was just a great experience. They met our expectations for everything that we needed, and I think overall we were just crazy happy.

Ron J
GUILDQUALITY
We couldn’t be happier with the end results

We felt they listened and answered all our concerns before beginning. We couldn’t be happier with the end results.

Briggs Rd. Church
GUILDQUALITY
Employees Were Beyond Professional and Friendly. 

The quality of work exceeded my expectations. When I reached out the them, they were attentive. The employees were beyond professional and friendly.

Julie N
GUILDQUALITY
Could Not Imagine Working With Any Other Builder

Stebnitz Builders builds trust from the initial meeting, through completion of the remodel. We could not imagine working with any other builder. The people and their expertise make this organization one of the finest in the industry.

Ray & Maureen M
GUILDQUALITY
Excellent Communication and Expertise

Once the project started, Alec single-handedly did an amazing job, with excellent communication and expertise in all aspects of the bathroom remodel.

Joy L
GUILD QUALITY
Talented and Knowledgeable Building Crew

Talented and knowledgeable building crew. Our lead carpenter was a young man who talked like he’d been in the business for 40 years. Foresaw issues and devised solutions that worked and were aesthetically pleasing.

Phil and Cheryl G.
GUILDQUALITY
Friendly, Personable, and Talented

The young man who worked on the project was very friendly, personable, and good at what he did.

Tom B.
GUILDQUALITY
On time, on budget, professional, quality workmanship.

On time, on budget, professional, quality workmanship. Ryan Hibl always returned calls, listened, followed through.

John and Joanne S.
GUILDQUALITY
Professional, Courteous, and Organized

The whole experience was very professional, courteous and organized. Craig and Scott’s work was total perfection which made the project stress free.

Mary K.
GUILDQUALITY
Perfect service and awesome carpenters.

Stebnitz Builders provided perfect service and had awesome carpenters.

Todd M.
GUILDQUALITY
Reputable and trustworthy general contractor.

Reputable and trustworthy general contractor. Performed their job in a professional manner, with good communication throughout the project.

Bruce and Marcia
GUILDQUALITY
No one is more reliable or has more integrity than Stebnitz Builders

As an interior design professional with Ann Oakes Design, nothing is more important to me than having a reliable network of quality contractors you can count on to help your client’s complete their residential projects. No one is more reliable or has more integrity than Stebnitz Builders. Their team is responsive, enthusiastic and skilled and work is completed at a high standard of quality and on time. Their work is impeccable and their integrity is rock solid. I highly recommend considering Stebnitz Builders for your next home improvement project!

Ann Oakes Design
HOUZZ
Always given honest

Chris Stebnitz is always given honest, optional and subjective information. When in the right situation I would hire Stebnitz Builders over any other company.

mbeacon
HOUZZ
Stebnitz Builders went above and beyond

Stebnitz Builders coordinated with the Make a Wish Foundation to grant my daughter’s wish for a family friendly basement rec room in our home. Stebnitz Builders went above and beyond by eliciting additional donations from a variety of area businesses. The space turned out great and continues to be a place where our family enjoys spending time together.

Suzette Nunez
HOUZZ
Top-notch in the building industry

Chris is been a valued mentor to me. His professionalism and knowledge in remodeling is evidenced by his willingness to help others and to encourage a top-notch building industry. His leadership in the Lakeland Builders Association helps him and others do their jobs well, creating a better experience for Stebnitz Builders remodeling clients!

Abe D.
YELP
Ryan, Scott and the rest of the crew were fantastic!

Ryan, Scott and the rest of the crew were fantastic! Kept the project moving and timely resolved all issues. Really listened to us and made sure we were happy every step of the way.

We are really happy that we went with Stebnitz Builders.

We are really happy that we went with Stebnitz Builders. They stand behind their work. The fact that they specialize in remodeling was a plus. There were able to anticipate most unusual things that came up and handled the unexpected very well.

Larry Bray
GOOGLE
Stebnitz builders does a fantastic job!

Stebnitz builders does a fantastic job ! From concept to build this staff is professional and willing to go above and beyond! This company is built on family and they support many local civic groups and always willing to help donate to a cause when needed !

Gina Dingman
FACEBOOK
Have had nothing but positive experiences

We have been working with Stebnitz Builders for 10+ years and have had nothing but positive experiences. Their commitment to customer service is unparalleled in the construction industry. We have come to trust and rely on their extensive knowledge of the services they offer for new homes, remodeling projects and historic preservation projects requiring precise replication of existing architectural details. They are prompt, courteous and a real pleasure to work with. We would not hesitate to refer customers to Stebnitz Builders, and we have.

OUR SERVICES
Signature Quality in Every Space

From whole-home resets to refined additions, we provide the design-build expertise and dedicated craftsmanship needed to bring your unique vision to life.

Restoration & Preservation
Repairs and updates to preserve a home’s historical architecture
LEARN MORE
QUALITY THAT ENDURES
Our Five-Year Workmanship Promise

While a one-year warranty is the industry standard, we believe our craftsmanship should be held to a higher level of accountability. At Stebnitz Builders, we guarantee our workmanship for five years. This extended commitment is a reflection of our attention to detail and the reason so many clients trust us with their homes time and time again. We don’t just build for today; we build for your future.

Learn About Our Warranty
Every great project starts with a conversation.

Contact our team today to discuss your goals and start the path toward a beautifully reimagined home. We’re here to listen to your ideas and help you discover the full potential of your space.

Get Started
Where We Build
A local legacy of high-quality renovation

Stebnitz Builders is proud to serve the premier lakefront communities of Walworth County, along with select regions of Rock, Jefferson, and Racine counties. A family-run business since 1972, Stebnitz Builders has completed hundreds of unique remodeling projects earning us the trust and accolades of our clients.

KITCHEN REMODELING & DESIGN
Creating the heart of your home with a disciplined, design-build approach.

Your kitchen is the central fixture of your household—a hub for family communication and a space for entertaining. Whether you require a complete layout redesign to improve workflow or an aesthetic update to modernize your home, our process ensures the result aligns with your lifestyle. We listen to your vision, validate your budget with an “Opinion of Probable Cost,” and deliver exceptional craftsmanship.

Start Your Kitchen Project
A Process-Driven Approach to Your Dream Kitchen
FROM "OPINION OF PROBABLE COST" TO FINAL WALKTHROUGH

A successful kitchen renovation requires more than just skilled carpentry; it requires a detailed roadmap. At Stebnitz Builders, we mitigate the stress of remodeling through our Project Development Agreement (PDA). During this 60-120 day phase, we don’t just sketch ideas; we finalize every detail—from custom cabinetry and quartz countertops to plumbing fixtures and paint colors—before construction ever begins.

This disciplined front-end planning ensures your project stays on budget and on schedule. Once construction starts, your dedicated Production Manager will ensure trade partners are coordinated and your daily life is respected. We replace the anxiety of “budget spiraling” with the confidence of a fixed contract and a clear path forward.

Curious About Remodeling Costs?
PLAN YOUR BUDGET WITH CONFIDENCE

Understanding the investment required for a remodel is the first step toward bringing your vision to life. Download our comprehensive Pricing Guide to see the most current cost ranges for kitchens, bathrooms, additions, and more in Walworth County.

GET THE GUIDE
WHY REMODEL YOUR KITCHEN?
Identifying the goals for your renovation.

Improve Workflow and Layout: Reconfiguring the "work triangle" to make cooking, cleaning, and moving through the kitchen more efficient and less crowded.

Modernize Outdated Aesthetics: Replacing worn cabinets, dark lighting, or old flooring to breathe new life and value into the home.

Expand for Entertaining: Removing walls or adding a central island to create an open-concept space that welcomes family and guests.

Increase Storage Capacity: Incorporating smart storage solutions like pantries, deep drawers, and custom cabinetry to reduce countertop clutter.

Design a tranquil retreat for your daily routine.

Your bathroom is where you start and end every day. It should be a place to prepare for the morning with energy and unwind in the evening with peace. Start Your Bathroom Project
Creating Your Personal Retreat

We guide you through the “Project Development” phase to select the perfect fixtures, lighting, and layout before demolition begins, ensuring a smooth production schedule.

We address common issues like poor ventilation, inefficient layouts, limited storage, outdated fixtures, and aging plumbing systems. HOME ADDITIONS
Expand your living space without leaving the home you love.

Sometimes, the best solution to a cramped layout is simply more space. Whether you need a larger kitchen, a primary suite sanctuary, or a sunroom to enjoy the outdoors year-round, Stebnitz Builders specializes in seamless home additions. We ensure your new space doesn’t just add square footage; it enhances your home’s character and functionality, looking as if it’s always been there.

Seamless Design. Expert Construction
VISUALIZING YOUR NEW SPACE BEFORE WE BREAK GROUND

Adding to your home is a significant structural undertaking that requires precise planning. Our design-build process focuses on architectural integrity—matching rooflines, siding, and interior flow so the addition feels like a natural extension of your existing home, not an afterthought.

During our Project Development phase, we utilize 3D color renderings and detailed interior layout views. This allows you to walk through your future space virtually, ensuring the design meets your vision and budget before construction begins. From navigating zoning ordinances in Walworth County to pouring new foundations, we manage every complex detail.

Curious About Remodeling Costs?
PLAN YOUR BUDGET WITH CONFIDENCE

Understanding the investment required for a remodel is the first step toward bringing your vision to life. Download our comprehensive Pricing Guide to see the most current cost ranges for kitchens, bathrooms, additions, and more in Walworth County.

GET THE GUIDE
POPULAR HOME ADDITION PROJECTS
Custom solutions for growing families and changing needs.

Master Suite Additions: Creating a private retreat with a luxury bathroom and walk-in closet on the main floor.

Kitchen Expansions: Bump-outs to accommodate dining areas, or pantries or a larger island for better entertaining.

Sunrooms & Three-Season Rooms: Bringing the outdoors in with light-filled spaces perfect for relaxation and enjoying nature.

Attached Garages: Adding vehicle storage or workshops with bonus rooms above for extra living space.

EXTERIOR HOME REMODELING
Revitalize your home’s appearance and protection from the elements.

Your home’s exterior is the first thing to welcome you back at the end of the day. Whether you are looking to refresh your siding, update your windows, or completely reimagine your home’s architectural style, Stebnitz Builders is here to help you create a look you love. We provide low-maintenance, durable solutions that boost curb appeal and protect your investment for decades to come.

Start Your Exterior Project
Durable Beauty, Expert Installation
ENHANCING ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND LONGEVITY

Exterior remodeling is about more than just aesthetics; it’s also the first line of defense against Wisconsin weather. Our design-build approach ensures that your new siding, roofing, and windows are not only beautiful but also properly integrated to prevent water intrusion and energy loss.

We guide you through selecting modern, maintenance-free materials that offer superior durability compared to previous generations of products. From the initial budgeting phase to the final installation of gutters and trim, we manage every detail. Our team ensures your home looks cohesive and stands strong against the elements, backed by our 5-year warranty.

Siding Replacement: Installing fiber cement or engineered wood siding for a vibrant, rot-resistant finish that mimics real wood without the upkeep.

Window & Door Replacement: Upgrading to energy-efficient models to reduce drafts, lower utility bills, and improve natural light.

Roofing & Gutters: Protecting your home’s structure with high-performance shingles and seamless gutter systems to manage water runoff.

Porches & Porticos: Adding a covered entry or wrap-around porch to create a welcoming focal point and usable outdoor living space.

LOWER-LEVEL & INTERIOR REMODELING
Unlock the hidden potential of your home’s existing footprint.

Your lower level can be so much more than storage. Imagine the opportunity to significantly expand your living space without changing your home’s exterior. Whether you dream of a dedicated home theater, a guest suite, or a custom bar for entertaining, Stebnitz Builders transforms underutilized basements and interior rooms into functional, beautiful extensions of your home. AGING IN PLACE & UNIVERSAL DESIGN
Beautiful, accessible solutions for your forever home

You love your home, your neighborhood, and your memories. There is no need to leave them behind just because your needs are changing. Stebnitz Builders specializes in “Aging in Place” renovations that blend safety with style. We create accessible environments that empower you to live independently and comfortably for years to come, without sacrificing the aesthetic quality of your home.

Plan Your Forever Home
Designing for Independence and Comfort
FUTURE-PROOFING YOUR HOME WITH UNIVERSAL DESIGN

Modifying a home for the future doesn’t mean making it look like a hospital. Our Aging-in-Place design-build approach utilizes “Universal Design” principles to create spaces that are safer and easier to use for everyone, regardless of age or ability. We seamlessly integrate features like wider doorways, zero-entry showers, and improved lighting into beautiful, modern remodeling projects.
Whether you are planning ahead for yourself or modifying a home for a loved one, our team guides you through the “Project Development” phase with empathy and expertise. We help you identify potential hazards and implement stylish solutions that ensure your home remains a sanctuary of safety and independence.

Curious About Remodeling Costs?
PLAN YOUR BUDGET WITH CONFIDENCE

Understanding the investment required for a remodel is the first step toward bringing your vision to life. Download our comprehensive Pricing Guide to see the most current cost ranges for kitchens, bathrooms, additions, and more in Walworth County.

GET THE GUIDE
KEY FEATURES FOR AGING IN PLACE
Safety meets sophistication

Main Floor Living: Relocating the primary suite and laundry room to the first floor to eliminate the daily need for stairs.

Accessible Bathrooms: Installing curbless walk-in showers, comfort-height toilets, and reinforced walls for stylish grab bars.

Kitchen Convenience: Lowering countertops, installing pull-out shelves, and using lever-style handles to make cooking easier and safer.

Improved Mobility: Widening hallways and doorways to accommodate walkers or wheelchairs, ensuring smooth transitions between rooms.

ARCHITECTURAL RESTORATION & PRESERVATION
Honoring the history of your home with master craftsmanship.

Some homes are more than just structures; they are pieces of history. Whether you own a classic Victorian in Lake Geneva or a century-old farmhouse in Walworth County, Stebnitz Builders understands the responsibility of stewardship. We don’t just remodel; we revive. Our team is dedicated to preserving the architectural integrity of your residence, bringing it back to its original glory while ensuring it is built to last for the next generation.

Discuss Your Restoration Project
Respecting the Past, Building for the Future
SEAMLESS INTEGRATION OF PERIOD-CORRECT DETAILS

True restoration requires a delicate balance between modern durability and historical accuracy. It is not about changing the home’s character, but rather uncovering and polishing the details that make it unique. Our design-build process begins with a deep study of your home’s existing architecture—from rooflines and millwork to masonry and siding profiles.

We work to ensure that any updates, whether exterior or interior, feel cohesive with the original structure. Our goal is to maintain the soul of the home. Through our “Project Development” phase, we source materials and craft custom solutions that respect the era of construction, ensuring the finished result looks as if it has always been there, only better.

Understanding the investment required for a remodel is the first step toward bringing your vision to life. Download our comprehensive Pricing Guide to see the most current cost ranges for kitchens, bathrooms, additions, and more in Walworth County.

GET THE GUIDE
PRESERVING YOUR HOME’S LEGACY
Revitalizing character-defining features.

Exterior Facade Restoration: Recreating intricate trim, corbels, or period-specific siding profiles that have deteriorated over time.

Porch & Veranda Revival: Stabilizing and rebuilding grand entryways and wrap-around porches to their original stature and curb appeal.

Window & Door Rehabilitation: Updating vintage openings with historically accurate replacements that offer modern energy efficiency without sacrificing style.

Interior Millwork Matching: custom-crafting molding, casings, and built-ins that perfectly replicate the home’s original woodwork and craftsmanship.

Craftsmanship in Every Detail

Explore a curated collection of our recent transformations across Southeastern Wisconsin. From sweeping lakefront estates to intimate interior resets, our work reflects our dedication to quality and the unique visions of our clients.

Setting the Standard for Lakeside Living

Our portfolio represents over fifty years of architectural excellence throughout Walworth County and the surrounding Southeastern Wisconsin region. While we are widely recognized for our specialized expertise in lake home renovations, our work spans a diverse range of styles—from historic downtown restorations to modern countryside retreats. As you explore our recent projects, you will find everything from whole-home resets and expansive additions to meticulously detailed interior remodels. Explore our project categories below.

We don’t just build for today; we build for your future.

Custom Bathroom Remodeling in Cary, NC

Plan a bathroom that works for your daily routine, with design consultation, material selection and installation from The Bath Remodeling Center in Cary. We help homeowners in Cary, Raleigh and Apex plan custom vanities, tile, showers, tubs, fixtures and finishes as part of a coordinated bathroom renovation.

Start with your goals: a better shower layout, more practical storage, updated finishes or a complete primary bathroom remodel. Explore our bathroom remodeling services and Cary design showroom to see how your ideas can take shape.

Contact Us Today!
Why Choose The Bath Remodeling Center For Your Home?

Compare more than finishes when choosing a bathroom remodeler. Look at completed work, how the design is developed and what the installation plan includes. Our before-and-after bathroom gallery lets you explore real projects, while our remodeling process explains the steps from planning to completion.

At our Cary showroom, you can compare tile, cabinetry, countertops and fixtures in person. Bring photos of your current bathroom and a list of what you want to change so the conversation starts with your needs. Contact our remodeling team to discuss your project.

Design Portfolio
Before & After
Why Choose Bath Remodeling Center
Our Process
Our Showroom Gallery

Our Latest Home Bath Designs and Remodels
NC LICENSED GENERAL CONTRACTOR #86537

The Bath Remodeling Center provides bathroom design and renovation services from our Cary, NC showroom. Our work includes design consultation, custom cabinetry, tile, fixtures and finishes. See our bath remodeling options to begin planning your space.

Plan the Bathroom Around How You Use It
Primary and Master Bathroom Remodeling

Start with the layout, not just the color palette. Think about the space around the vanity, how the shower opens, where towels belong and whether the existing tub fits your routine. Bring these priorities to your consultation so storage, fixture placement and finish selections can be considered together.

Showers, Tubs and Tile

Compare the shower enclosure, wall and floor finishes, fixtures and cleaning needs as a complete design. Our service options include frameless showers, tubs and a range of tile selections. In the bathroom showroom, you can see materials in person and discuss how different choices could work in your home.

Vanities, Storage and Finishing Details

A custom vanity is an opportunity to improve both storage and daily use. Consider drawer space, countertop room and how the doors open within your layout. Coordinate cabinetry, mirrors, faucets and other finishes before finalizing the design rather than making each selection in isolation.

From Initial Ideas to a Remodeling Plan
Describe what needs to change. Share photos of the room, the features you want to keep and the problems you want the remodel to solve.
Explore design and material options. Use the showroom to compare tile, fixtures, cabinetry and finishes alongside your project goals.
Review the proposed scope. Discuss what is included, how selections affect the estimate and the expected installation sequence before work begins.

Read our bathroom remodeling process for more detail. Your initial home visit and first showroom appointment are offered at no cost, along with a complimentary remodeling estimate. More extensive consultations beyond those initial steps may involve consultation fees.

Questions to Bring to Your Bathroom Consultation
What affects the cost of a bathroom remodel?

The size of the room is only one factor. A change to the layout, the scope of plumbing or electrical work, cabinetry, tile and fixture selections can all affect the estimate. Identify your must-have improvements first, then discuss alternatives with the team before approving the scope.

How should I prepare for a showroom appointment?

Bring photos, approximate room dimensions if available, a list of your priorities and examples of styles you like. Let the team know if ease of access, storage, cleaning or keeping a bathtub is especially important. These details help make the consultation specific to your household.

Can I see examples of completed work?

Yes. Browse our completed bathroom transformations and customer reviews. Look for projects with layouts or features similar to yours, then bring those examples to the discussion.

We serve Cary, Raleigh, Apex and other communities listed on our service-area page. Request a bathroom remodeling consultation with your location and the changes you have in mind.

About
Our Team: Your Bath Remodeling Experts
 

At The Bath Remodeling Center, we are passionate about transforming bathrooms into stunning, functional spaces that exceed our customers’ expectations. With over 25 years of experience in the industry, our expert team brings creativity, craftsmanship, and attention to detail to every project we undertake. From concept to completion, we work closely with our clients to understand their vision and deliver customized solutions that suit their needs and style preferences. Whether it’s a small update or a complete overhaul, we take pride in our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction. Trust us to turn your bathroom dreams into reality.

OWNER
Nicole Fella

Nicole Fella is a seasoned professional in the realm of interior design and construction, with a passion for transforming spaces into exquisite works of art. Having graduated from the prestigious Fashion Institute of Technology (F.I.T.) in New York with a degree in Interior Design, Nicole honed her skills and expertise in creating aesthetically pleasing and functional environments.

With a dedication to excellence, Nicole pursued further qualifications and became a NASCLA Licensed General Contractor, demonstrating her commitment to mastering every aspect of the construction process. Over the past 11 years, she has been an integral part of The Bath Remodeling Center,LLC.  where her talent and leadership have contributed significantly to the company’s success.

Now, as the proud owner of The Bath Remodeling Center, LLC. Nicole brings her wealth of experience and creative vision to every project. With an unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction and a keen eye for detail, she leads her team in delivering exceptional results that exceed clients’ expectations.

Nicole’s innovative approach to design, combined with her expertise in construction, allows her to transform ordinary spaces into extraordinary havens that reflect her clients’ unique tastes and lifestyles. Her dedication to quality craftsmanship and personalized service sets her apart in the industry, making her a trusted partner for those seeking to elevate their living spaces to new heights.

Team Excellence: The Driving Force Behind Bath Remodeling Center's Success
Our Team
Contact Us

At The Bath Remodeling Center, our team is more than just a group of individuals – they’re the heartbeat of our company. We deeply value each member, recognizing their unique talents and contributions. From our skilled craftsmen who bring visions to life, to our attentive customer service representatives who ensure every client feels heard and supported, every person plays a vital role in our success.

 

About The Bath Remodeling Center
Bath Renovation Experts: The Bath Remodeling Center

The Bath Remodeling Center, LLC, previously Portofino Tile, has flourished into a prominent Triangle area business, boasting a remarkable track record of over $15 million in successfully completed projects to date. Visit our expansive 5,000 sq ft showroom and facility collection in Downtown Cary, where you can explore a wide selection of premium bath and tile products from various esteemed manufacturers. Our team of highly skilled craftsmen is committed to delivering swift, efficient, and error-free renovations, ensuring your project is executed flawlessly the first time. Don’t just take our word for it; read our heartfelt customer reviews to witness the satisfaction of our delighted clientele.

See Our Reviews
The Bath Remodeling Center: Honored with 2025 & 2026 Maggy Awards

We are thrilled to announce that The Bath Remodeling Center has been recognized with the prestigious Maggy Award for both 2025 and 2026. Voted on by our local community, these back-to-back honors highlight our unwavering commitment to craftsmanship, exceptional service, and quality bathroom transformations. We are deeply grateful for your continued trust throughout 2025 and into 2026!
